narrative.overview: DenCli embodies a high-trust, modern European dental healthcare philosophy. The aesthetic avoids cold sterile hospital tropes and generic corporate SaaS palettes alike, projecting instead the serene authority of an advanced dental atelier.

rules.name: The High-Contrast Integrity Rule
rules.body: No functional text or actionable metadata may use gray lighter than #334155 on light surfaces or darker than #CBD5E1 on dark surfaces.

rules.name: The One Crimson Rule
rules.body: Red (#DC2626) is exclusively reserved for cancellation confirmations, clinical allergy warnings, and session termination (Đăng xuất).

rules.name: The Heading Immersion Rule
rules.body: Any dark container must render headings in pure white (#FFFFFF) and supporting copy in icy sky tints (#E0F2FE or #CBD5E1).

rules.name: The Flat-Rest Floating-Active Rule
rules.body: Cards and data containers remain anchored to the canvas with crisp border lines at rest; glow and elevation appear strictly as dynamic feedback.

dos: Do maintain #334155 or darker for all secondary descriptions, sublabels, and timestamps to ensure WCAG AA readability.
Do confirm cancellations and destructive actions inside dedicated Bootstrap 5 dialogs with explicit reason dropdowns.
Do display instantaneous feedback on asynchronous actions using toast notifications and localized DOM swaps.
Do provide print-optimized layouts (@media print) for invoices and medical prescriptions.
donts: Don't use faint gray (#94A3B8 or #CBD5E1) for body text on white backgrounds.
Don't render dark navbars with generic gray logout links; always use the high-contrast .btn-nav-logout button.
Don't perform full page reloads when confirming appointment status changes; use realtime DOM updates with toast confirmations.
Don't invent arbitrary colors outside the cyan/navy/slate/crimson palette system.
